# FAIE Evidence-First Signal Brief commercial intent cluster

Public ID: faie-signal-brief-v1
Problem: A buyer has one bounded agriculture, land, water, production or resilience question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation.
Pricing: Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time. Other intake categories are not auto-quotable.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready

## Boundary

- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout requires explicit human confirmation where supported.
- Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
